title: Let the conversation archive backup copy live outside the synced tree
notes: Observation: scribe backupConversationArchive (scribe/scripts/lib/conversations/backupConversationArchive.ts) writes a full 8-10 GiB clone as archive.jsonl.backup-<stamp> beside archive.jsonl, hardcoded via dirname(archive); no directory option. Backblaze re-uploaded each copy; excluded by hand-edited rule 033 on 2026-11-23 (dotfiles/backblaze/README.md). Smallest next step: add an env/option for the backup directory (default ~/.cache/atrium/archive-backups, already excluded) in scribe, update pruneConversationArchiveBackups to look there, and drop rule 033 once moved.
done_when: backup copies are written under ~/.cache/atrium and prune finds them
